story_text: As a guest, I want to create a booking with the maximum allowed guests (10) so that boundary values are handled correctly.

positive.title: Create booking with 1 guest (lower boundary — valid)
steps: 1. Send POST request to /bookings with guests = 10

positive.title: Create booking with exactly 10 guests (upper boundary — valid)
steps: 1. Send POST request to /bookings with guests = 10
positive.expected_result: 201 Created · booking persisted with guests = 10 confirmed in response

positive.title: Create booking with 9 guests (upper boundary − 1)
steps: 1. Send POST request to /bookings with guests = 9

negative.title: Create booking with 11 guests (upper boundary + 1 — invalid)
steps: 1. Send POST request to /bookings with guests = 11
negative.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · message states maximum is 10 guests

negative.title: Create booking with 0 guests (lower boundary − 1 — invalid)
steps: 1. Send POST request to /bookings with guests = 0
negative.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · at least 1 guest required

negative.title: Create booking with negative guest count
steps: 1. Send POST request to /bookings with guests = -5

edge.title: Create booking with a decimal guest count
steps: 1. Send POST request to /bookings with guests = 5.5
edge.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · non-integer rejected, or value truncated per defined behaviour

edge.title: Create booking with guest count as a string
steps: 1. Send POST request to /bookings with guests = "5"
edge.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · type validation enforced, or coerced per API contract

edge.title: Create booking with guests field missing
steps: 1. Send POST request to /bookings without guests field
